description: List the extra pieces that can go in each envelope with a Premier Letters order: printed inserts, printed letters, your own inserts, flyers, postcards, business cards. Each has options, a per-unit price in cents, a lead time and a purchase mode: "instant" pieces are charged with the order, "request" pieces are priced by staff after the order is placed. Pass them as `extras` on create_order. With an API key, the account's own prices apply.
name: list_extras
